newsitem.title: JAPAN: Two U.S. landing craft sink off Okinawa, none hurt.
newsitem.headline: Two U.S. landing craft sink off Okinawa, none hurt.

text.p: Two U.S. Navy amphibious landing craft sank off the coast of the southern Japan island of Okinawa on Monday but nobody was hurt, a Japanese navy spokesman said.
The landing craft were involved in a U.S. Marine Corps landing exercise off Camp Schwab on the Pacific coast of Okinawa, the Japanese navy spokesman said. All the crewmembers were rescued, he added.
The reason for the sinking was unclear. U.S. military spokesmen were not immediately available for comment.
